Does one threshold hold in every group?

Source: R/threshold_workflow.R
threshold_by_group.Rd

A threshold set for a whole site x species cell can give the target precision on average and miss it in some months, hours or chorus conditions. For each cell and each level of the by columns, this function computes the precision of the reviewed clips at or above the threshold of the cell, weighted by 1 / inclusion_prob when the clips have it, and flags the groups below target_precision.

Usage

threshold_by_group(
  validation,
  thresholds,
  by,
  target_precision = 0.9,
  min_n = 15,
  threshold_column = "threshold"
)

Arguments

validation

Table returned by classify_review().

thresholds

The threshold of each cell: a table with site, species_folder and a threshold column (e.g. from suggest_thresholds(); threshold_column picks another column, such as "threshold_conservative" of threshold_bootstrap()), or a single number for every cell.

by

Columns of validation that define the groups, e.g. "recording_hour" or a month column.

target_precision

Target precision.

min_n

Minimum of reviewed clips for a bin to be taken seriously; bins with fewer are flagged in low_support.

threshold_column

Column of thresholds with the threshold.

Value

A tibble with site, species_folder, the by columns, threshold, n_above (reviewed clips at or above it), n_eff (effective sample size of Kish, with weights), precision_above and below_target. A group with fewer than min_n clips above the threshold gets below_target = NA.

See also

threshold_bootstrap(), threshold_record().
